caseName: Garis v. Compania Maritima San Basilio, S. A.
caseNameFull: Garis v. Compania Maritima San Basilio, S. A.

opinions.text: Appeal from App. Div., Sup. Ct. N. Y., 1st Jud. Dept., dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied.
